title: GLACE Switzerland (preliminary) – Sentinel-1 Glacier Coherence and Backscatter
description:
Annual summer composites of Sentinel-1 12-day repeat-pass interferometric coherence (COH12) and radiometrically terrain-corrected backscatter (RTC). The data covers the Alpine Convention perimeter, 2021–2024. The analysis-ready composites are locally resolution weighted (LRW) after [Small et al. (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2021.3055562), so each output pixel is dominated by acquisitions with high spatial resolution. Each year's 90-day averaging period was chosen by minimizing the MODIS NDSI over the target area.

The composites are available in two separate collections: tiles (10 km × 10 km MGRS grid squares, UTM, 10 m grid spacing) and mosaics on one fixed equal-area grid (ETRS89-LAEA, 40 m grid spacing). Every raster is a LERC-compressed, cloud-optimized GeoTIFF carrying the full processing record in its own tags. In addition, raster PMTiles in Web Mercator are provided for web maps, such as the [GLACE Viewer](https://lqgentner.github.io/glace-viewer).
